title: TrackerNotificationService

outputs.name: TrackerNotificationService.tick
outputs.description: Resolves after pending receipt replay, item scanning and eligible delivery for this tick.

outputs.name: TrackerNotificationService.enqueue
outputs.description: Commits a deduplicated queue intent on the hub. Delivery waits for a tick.

outputs.name: TrackerNotificationService.pause
outputs.description: Commits the first pause time and its actor on the hub.

outputs.name: TrackerNotificationService.resume
outputs.description: Clears the pause, resets pending outbox retries and drains work with one forced catch-up batch.

outputs.name: nextAttention
outputs.description: Prepared Chief of Staff batch when eligible. Drops obsolete or superseded lines and records the attempt window.

outputs.name: initializeAttention
outputs.description: Seeds the observed item state and carries forward still-relevant unsent legacy flags and blocks.

outputs.name: attentionState
outputs.description: Snapshot of status, escalation eligibility and resolution.

outputs.name: needsAttention
outputs.description: Whether the observed state represents an unresolved flag for an active item.

outputs.name: enqueueTransition
outputs.description: Queues the transition under its item and clock key, superseding older unsent lines of the same kind.

outputs.name: observeAttention
outputs.description: Applies one operation to the observed state and records a newly entered attention state.

outputs.name: launchWaitLine
outputs.description: Legacy launch-wait message with its item and launch token.

outputs.name: queueLaunchWait
outputs.description: Adds or refreshes the pending launch hold under the same launch token.

outputs.name: scanCallbacks
outputs.description: Adds eligible local completion events once per item clock and callback target.

outputs.name: nextCallback
outputs.description: Earliest eligible completion callback request, with an HTTP envelope or command variables.

outputs.name: completeDelivery
outputs.description: Commits the delivery receipt or next retry and clears the issued request in the same transaction.

outputs.name: webhookRequest
outputs.description: JSON body and HTTP headers carrying the same webhook event ID.

outputs.name: callbackRequest
outputs.description: JSON body and the legacy HTTP headers or command environment for the callback.

outputs.name: scanDirectReminders
outputs.description: Inserts reminders for current flags and due items, and closes inactive rows.

outputs.name: nextDirectReminder
outputs.description: One grouped reminder request, or an empty result when no reminder row is ready to send.

outputs.name: enqueueWebhook
outputs.description: Queues a recurring wake-up, dispatcher summary or launch hold for later processing.

outputs.name: minute
outputs.description: Number of milliseconds in one minute.

outputs.name: intervalMs
outputs.description: Duration in milliseconds, applying the default for absent or zero values.

outputs.name: isoTime
outputs.description: ISO UTC timestamp.

outputs.name: clockTime
outputs.description: Epoch milliseconds parsed from the Tracker clock, with zero for a missing or malformed clock.

outputs.name: eventId
outputs.description: First 32 hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 digest of the sorted keys.

outputs.name: activeItem
outputs.description: Whether the row represents an active Tracker item.

outputs.name: flagged
outputs.description: Whether an active item has an unresolved needs-Daniel flag.

outputs.name: dueTime
outputs.description: Exact due instant, or null for a missing or invalid due value. Date-only dues use local midnight.

outputs.name: localDay
outputs.description: Numeric local calendar day in year, month and day order.

outputs.name: readyRows
outputs.description: Eligible rows ordered by their creation time, retaining insertion order on ties.

outputs.name: runNotificationTick
outputs.description: Replays any issued receipt, scans current state and drains eligible delivery work.

outputs.name: attentionOutboxEvent
outputs.description: Whether the row is a due event or an ask that needs current attention eligibility.

outputs.name: nextOutbox
outputs.description: Next grouped or single webhook request after routing, collapsing and eligibility checks.

outputs.name: outboxBatch
outputs.description: Grouped outbox request with a stable ID, item payloads, recurring wake-ups and counts.

outputs.name: outboxSingle
outputs.description: Single outbox request with the legacy payload, current attempt number and send time.

outputs.name: enqueueEvent
outputs.description: Adds the immutable event snapshot when its queue key is new.

outputs.name: itemEvent
outputs.description: Legacy item event payload with its clock-derived fields and hashed queue key.

outputs.name: summaryEvent
outputs.description: Legacy auto-launch summary with its deterministic event ID.

outputs.name: normalizeActor
outputs.description: Trimmed, lowercase name for case-insensitive matching.

outputs.name: scanWebhookEvents
outputs.description: Bootstraps or advances the cursor in the same transaction as its classified events.

outputs.name: scanWebhookFlags
outputs.description: Advances active flag escalations and groups imminent reminders with a due ping.

outputs.name: scanWebhookDue
outputs.description: Queues each eligible non-recurring due clock once.

errors.name: TrackerNotificationStateError
errors.description: The journal cursor does not advance or an issued request refers to a missing queue row. Injected source, queue and destination failures propagate to the caller.
